nodes.description: Address stored as the owner of the Account contract; controls privileged role management.
Mapping of admin addresses; admins can grant and revoke operator roles.
Mapping of operator addresses; operators may withdraw assets and invoke arbitrary calls.
Governance address of the factory; controls accountBase updates and governance transfer.
Base Account implementation address used as logic for newly created proxies.
Mapping from user address to their latest created Account proxy address.
EIP-1967 storage slot holding the implementation address read/written via assembly sload/sstore.
EIP-1967 storage slot holding the proxy admin address read/written via assembly sload/sstore.
Flag indicating that the initializer has already been executed for this contract instance.
Initializer that sets the owner and grants the initial admin roles; guarded by the initializer modifier.
Transfers ownership of the Account to a new address; only callable by the current owner.
Grants admin role to an address; restricted to the owner via require(msg.sender == owner).
Revokes admin role from an address; restricted to the owner.
Grants operator role; callable by owner or any existing admin.
Revokes operator role; callable by owner or any existing admin.
View helper returning whether an address is owner, admin, or operator; backs the onlyOperator modifier.
Withdraws ETH via targetAddress.transfer; restricted to operators through onlyOperator.
Withdraws ERC20 tokens using safeTransfer; restricted to operators.
Withdraws ERC20 tokens and falls through to the owner's balance/allowance if the Account balance is insufficient.
Approves an ERC20 spender, resetting allowance to zero first; restricted to operators.
Performs an arbitrary low-level call with value on an attacker/operator-supplied target and data.
Updates the base Account implementation; restricted to governance.
Updates the governance address; restricted to the current governance.
Deploys an AdminUpgradeabilityProxy over accountBase and initializes a new Account for the caller.
Changes the proxy admin; guarded by the ifAdmin modifier which checks msg.sender == _admin().
Changes the proxy implementation address; guarded by ifAdmin.
Assembly delegatecall forwarding of msg.data to the implementation, copying return data back to the caller.
Fallback implementation that runs _willFallback then delegates to _implementation().
Writes the new admin address into ADMIN_SLOT via assembly sstore.
Validates that the new implementation is a contract and stores it into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Library helper that forwards ETH with a full-gas low-level call and reverts on failure.
Internal helper performing a low-level call with value and bubbling up revert reasons.
Wrapper executing ERC20 calls through Address.functionCall and decoding optional boolean return data.
Sets governance to msg.sender and stores the initial account base implementation.
Caller address used for access-control checks in Account (owner/admin/operator).
Caller address becoming the proxy admin and Account owner during account creation.
Deployer address assigned as the initial governance of the factory.
targetAddress.transfer(amount): ETH value transfer to an operator-supplied address.
target.call{value: value}(data): arbitrary external call from the Account with arbitrary value and calldata.
delegatecall(gas(), implementation, ...): proxy forwards execution to an upgradable implementation address.
recipient.call{value: amount}(''): full-gas ETH send to a caller-supplied recipient.
target.call{value: weiValue}(data): low-level call executed inside the Address library.
Low-level call to an arbitrary token address performed by SafeERC20._callOptionalReturn.
Library helper using extcodehash to check whether an address holds contract code.
New owner address passed into Account.initialize.
Array of addresses granted the admin role during initialization.
New owner address supplied to transferOwnership.
Recipient of the ETH withdrawal from the Account.
Amount of ETH to withdraw from the Account.
ERC20 token address to withdraw.
Recipient address for the ERC20 withdrawal.
Amount of ERC20 tokens to withdraw.
ERC20 token address used in the fall-through withdrawal.
Recipient address used in the fall-through withdrawal.
Total amount requested by the fall-through withdrawal.
Arbitrary contract address the Account will call.
ETH value forwarded with the arbitrary call.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded with the call.
Admin addresses passed to the new Account's initialize call.
Recipient of the ETH sent by Address.sendValue.
Amount of ETH sent by Address.sendValue.
New base Account implementation address supplied to the factory.
New governance address supplied to the factory.
Cached ERC20 balance of the Account used to branch between direct transfer and owner fall-through.
Newly deployed AdminUpgradeabilityProxy instance.
Account interface bound to the freshly deployed proxy.
Caller address checked against governance in setAccountBase and setGovernance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner before ownership is transferred.
Owner state variable gates execution of transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into the owner state variable.
msg.sender must equal owner to grant an admin role.
owner guards grantAdmin.
grantAdmin sets admins[_account] = true.
msg.sender must equal owner to revoke an admin role.
owner guards revokeAdmin.
revokeAdmin sets admins[_account] = false.
msg.sender must be owner or admin to grant operator roles.
owner is part of the grantOperator authorization check.
admins[msg.sender] is part of the grantOperator authorization check.
grantOperator sets operators[_account] = true.
msg.sender must be owner or admin to revoke operator roles.
owner is part of the revokeOperator authorization check.
admins[msg.sender] is part of the revokeOperator authorization check.
revokeOperator sets operators[_account] = false.
isOperator compares the queried address against owner.
isOperator consults the admins mapping.
isOperator consults the operators mapping.
msg.sender is validated through isOperator before ETH withdrawal.
onlyOperator modifier relies on isOperator(msg.sender).
targetAddress parameter is the destination of the ETH transfer.
amount parameter is the value transferred.
withdraw executes targetAddress.transfer.
onlyOperator gates withdrawToken.
tokenAddress selects the ERC20 contract to call.
targetAddress is the recipient of the ERC20 transfer.
amount is forwarded to safeTransfer.
withdrawToken performs an external ERC20 call through SafeERC20.
changeImplementation delegates to the internal _setImplementation routine.
onlyOperator gates withdrawTokenFallThrough.
tokenAddress selects the ERC20 contract.
targetAddress receives the tokens.
amount drives the balance branch and subtraction.
tokenBalance local is assigned from IERC20.balanceOf(address(this)).
tokenBalance is compared against amount to choose the withdrawal path.
owner address is used as the safeTransferFrom source in the fall-through path.
Multiple external ERC20 calls occur before the Withdrawn event, allowing a malicious token to reenter.
onlyOperator gates approveToken.
approveToken triggers external ERC20 approve calls via SafeERC20.
onlyOperator gates the arbitrary invoke call.
target parameter is the callee of the arbitrary call.
value parameter is forwarded as ETH to the callee.
data parameter is forwarded as calldata to the callee.
invoke performs an arbitrary external call on an operator-supplied target.
The untrusted target can call back into Account state before the call returns.
msg.sender must equal governance to update the account base.
governance guards setAccountBase.
The _accountBase parameter is written into the accountBase state variable.
msg.sender must equal governance to transfer governance.
governance guards setGovernance.
The _governance parameter is written into the governance state variable.
The deployer becomes the initial governance in the constructor.
accountBase is used as the implementation for the new proxy.
msg.sender becomes the proxy admin and Account owner during creation.
createAccount deploys a new AdminUpgradeabilityProxy stored in the local proxy variable.
The proxy address is cast into the local Account variable.
The freshly created Account proxy is initialized via an external call.
Caller-supplied initial admins are passed into the new Account's initialize.
The accounts mapping is keyed by the caller's msg.sender.
createAccount records the new Account address for the caller.
The stored value is the address of the newly created Account.
The initializer modifier reads the initialized flag before running the body.
The top-level initializer call sets initialized to true.
The _owner parameter is assigned to the owner state variable.
The _initialAdmins array entries are written into the admins mapping.
The _owner parameter provided by the caller becomes the new owner.
ifAdmin compares msg.sender against the stored admin address.
The ADMIN_SLOT value gates the ifAdmin-protected changeAdmin.
changeAdmin calls _setAdmin to persist the new admin.
_setAdmin writes the new admin address into ADMIN_SLOT.
The slot variable used for the sstore derives from ADMIN_SLOT.
ifAdmin compares msg.sender against the admin before upgrading.
_setImplementation stores the implementation into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
The slot variable derives from IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
_setImplementation validates the new implementation through Address.isContract.
_delegate executes delegatecall into the upgradable implementation.
The delegatecalled implementation executes in the proxy's storage context and may reenter.
_fallback delegates execution to _delegate(_implementation()).
sendValue performs a full-gas low-level call to a recipient address.
The recipient parameter is the target of the low-level call.
The amount parameter is forwarded as the call value.
_functionCallWithValue executes a value-bearing low-level call to an arbitrary target.
The called target can reenter or revert with data that must be bubbled up.
_callOptionalReturn routes the token call through Address.functionCall.
The token address is invoked with a low-level call that may execute malicious code.

Amount parameter scoped to the fall-through withdrawal.
Target address parameter flows directly into the arbitrary call.
Value parameter flows directly into the arbitrary call.
Calldata parameter flows directly into the arbitrary call.
Admin list parameter is forwarded to the new Account's initialize.
Recipient parameter of the Address library ETH send.
Amount parameter of the Address library ETH send.
Implementation parameter assigned to the accountBase state variable.
Governance parameter assigned to the governance state variable.
Cached balance local used only for the branch inside the same function.
Temporary proxy handle used only within account creation.
Temporary Account handle used only within account creation.
